build_jais_inference_model: build an inference-only Jais language model compatible with HuggingFace weights using vLLM
create_jais_attention: create a JAISAttention module with QKV parallel linear layers and optional ALiBi slopes for tensor-parallel inference
build_jais_mlp: build a JAISMLP feedforward block with optional SwiGLU activation and parallel linear layers
build_jais_transformer: build a JAISModel transformer with embedding layers, stacked JAISBlocks, and tensor-parallel layer slicing
create_jais_lm_head: create a JAISLMHeadModel with transformer backbone, tied or parallel LM head, and logits processor for inference
